_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Richard Aldington (1892-1962) as translator: Cyrano de Bergerac's Voyages to the Moon and the Sun (1923), Benda's The Great Betrayal (1928) and Sologub's The Little Demon (1916, with John Cournos), and the Letters of Voltaire and Frederick the Great (1927, round 55). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 29); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 92 gap-fill: Goldoni's The Good-Humoured Ladies (1922).
